name: branding-blue-lime-brand-guideline-template-overview
title: Blue and Lime Brand Guideline Template
whatItIs: A periwinkle sheet with a big 'Brand Guideline / Visual Identity' title and a 3-by-7 grid of slide thumbnails: navy section dividers with ghost numerals, and white pages for logo, colour, typography, imagery and stationery.
whatItMeans: Showing every slide type in one overview sells a template's completeness, while lime and blue keep it energetic.
techniques: Dark divider slides with big ghost numerals between content sections
Lime tag label for the 'Customizable Template' claim
3D chrome-blob imagery as a modern accent
Consistent lime and cobalt colour pairing

vocabulary.definition: A slide that introduces a new part of a document.
A sheet showing all pages of a template at small scale.
An oversized faint number used as a decorative marker.
